purpose: Golden, outcome-oriented MCP tasks used by the opt-in local evaluation runner.

cases.outcome: A ranked list of uncovered red regions with compact evidence.

cases.prompt: What got impacted since the previous session?
cases.outcome: Grouped regressions and improvements without returning every covered line.

cases.prompt: Show the red portions in one file.
cases.outcome: GitHub-like red ranges first, with exact selected lines only when requested.

cases.prompt: Show the source around this uncovered range.
cases.outcome: Numbered source lines annotated red, green, yellow, or gray for one contiguous range or a bounded batch.

cases.prompt: The checkout and test command are unchanged. Should I rerun the test?
cases.outcome: The server returns the latest compatible terminal run instead of launching duplicate work.

cases.prompt: How has this line behaved over time?
cases.outcome: A compact history for one file and line, with detailed mode reserved for an audit.

cases.prompt: Did the new code get covered after the test run?
cases.outcome: One bounded review with baseline/current metrics, changed regions, and optional source context.

cases.prompt: Show the last two coverage runs and summarize the last ten.
cases.outcome: Two detailed points plus an aggregate historical window without dumping every file.

cases.prompt: Run the approved test and show the relevant failure evidence.
cases.outcome: Discover approved commands, submit asynchronously, respect polling, then search targeted logs.

cases.prompt: Do I need a run_id to read the last run, or can run_review select it automatically?
cases.outcome: The agent understands that project_context exposes latest_run.id and run_review requires that explicit id.
